decisions_reviewed.decision: Presentación esencial ordenada y cierre manual por sala. Las ampliaciones, la práctica física, los aciertos y la manipulación manual son opcionales. La alternativa asistida presenta el contenido esencial antes del cierre.

No convertir activityContinued, activity_skipped, skip_remaining ni completedStations aislado en esencia OBS03. Preservar bytes, puntos y crédito de ruta; legacy_unknown reanuda la primera presentación esencial sin evidencia. La compatibilidad de Mirador requiere evidencia observada coherente, nunca solo un string de sesión.
decisions_reviewed.rationale: No existe un marcador antiguo durable de finalReached y Sala IV limpia legítimamente su checkpoint tras el QR; la procedencia no siempre puede reconstruirse.

decisions_reviewed.decision: La versión ES parte del literal del escritor según su acción y destino semántico, conservando palabras y orden. La división y los recortes exactos se trazan por posiciones. Las erratas, instrucciones espaciales y puntuación dinámica llevan parches explícitos. El copy funcional nuevo queda separado.

EN usa traducciones fieles de los segmentos ES conciliados, con la misma estructura e IDs. El selector inglés no acredita la traducción de las salas que hoy están fijas en ES. Verificar ambos idiomas, sin atribuir las traducciones EN al escritor como literales.

Texto principal con objetivo de 16 px o más y line-height de 1.45. Controles funcionales de al menos 48×48 CSS px donde el layout lo permita; opciones de V de al menos 96 px de alto. Contraste de lectura objetivo de 4.5:1 y estados o foco de 3:1, comprobados sobre el fondo real. Son criterios del plan, no una declaración de certificación.

I.event: Confirmar el avance o cierre de cada bloque básico en orden; el cierre final de Mediación produce essentialClosed1.

II.event: Presentar contenidos y resultados esenciales de las 6 capas en orden y confirmar el cierre de Música. La representación completa debe haberse presentado antes de habilitar la salida.
II.assisted_path: Ver resultado presenta los pasos de captura o mapeo, o la convergencia completa, con estado assisted. No registra una interacción manual inexistente.
optional: esperar duración completa de una animación tras pedir ver su resultado

completion_contract.qr_visibility: No montar controles QR en I–IV antes de verificar essentialClosed. Revalidar en gate, callback, loader y resolución de URL o payload; ocultar con CSS no basta. Excepción: contexto de Mirador validado por derecho final real o compatibilidad documentada.
completion_contract.legacy_route_continuation: Un destino ya adquirido mediante legacyRouteCredit puede retomarse con una acción explícita después de confirmar la esencia vigente pendiente. Crear pendingTransition de tipo legacy_resume y aplicar el mismo límite de carga de 15 s, primer render protegido y entrega verificada. No inventar un nuevo QR ni escribir otro bit global ya adquirido. Los destinos nunca adquiridos conservan su QR normal.

facts.fact: activateConcept stores visits/highest at opening. Closing Relation/Perception only sets transient panelClosed, intro has no close button. Mediation close stores ready/activityContinued. There is no durable confirmation for each of four essential blocks.

The v1 validator couples six-layer navigation to completedRequiredInteractions, full capture prefix and mappingFirstRunComplete. An assisted traversal cannot honestly write six visited layers into this old shape with manual flags false.
facts.proposal_pending: Keep legacy manual checkpoint untouched; let OBS03 essential registry carry presented/confirmed/assisted progression and let the consumer render/navigate from that separate state. Root may instead authorize a new schema with explicit origins. Never fill old manual facts to satisfy validation.

facts.fact: Resolved visual stage begins at6300ms, onComplete at9000ms; no visibility listener pauses/settles sequence. onComplete changes transient boolean. continueActivity checks exploration/mapping, not this boolean. R1 requires final presentation plus explicit manual closure, not timer or QR.

Both QR controls currently mount on storage/assets readiness; onBeforeOpen marks continuation. They must be consumers of root current-revision essence/revisit authorization and create no artificial essential facts.
facts.boundary: Root owns QR/preparer/router/progress/reset and transition commit. Agent B owns only I/II render/events and text slots; shared APIs not yet implemented.

facts.fact: Global bits with missing older fields cause current consumers to synthesize complete/highest states. Migration must read original storage first; synthesized UI state is not grandfathering evidence.

I/II slot objects are resolved at module load without locale, with fixed ES integration overrides, readouts and functional labels. Root must provide shared locale-aware registry/navigation API; agent adapts consumers at render time and flags any missing translation. document.lang alone is not evidence.

More is inside the scrollable masked copy track. Need visible control outside mask, semantic expanded relation and readable content; no measured contrast or viewport PASS is claimed in this read-only round.

lia_roles.production_condition: The action is required; a newly choreographed existing rig can satisfy it without generating a bitmap. Inspect actual source layers and the real room before choosing rig or clip. Generate only the missing role/style variant; do not blindly produce six sheets. Six frames and the stated dimensions are the compact production proposal, not a human-approved immutable requirement. Moving one unchanged full-body bitmap across the screen is insufficient: the role needs a visible coordinated orientation/petal/body response plus the room event and arrival behavior. A layered rig may implement this without new raster frames.

questions_for_r3.question: Confirm that assisted II advances in the new essential registry without filling legacy completedRequiredInteractions/capture/mapping fields. Is a root-owned new typed checkpoint/schema required, or should the existing manual checkpoint remain solely a historical fact source?
questions_for_r3.why: The current v1 validator cannot represent assisted later-layer navigation honestly.

questions_for_r3.question: Publish the exact root API for current-revision presented/confirmed/closed events, atomic failure/retry, validated Mirador exception and passive preparation lifecycle before I/II implementation.
questions_for_r3.why: R1 defines semantic fields but not callable interfaces. A protected render must not write visits/confirmations, run arrival timers or announce live content.

questions_for_r3.question: Clarify legacy_unknown with historical visited/opened evidence but no manual closure IDs: is the first unproven OBS03 confirmation always intro/Plant, preserving old facts as support only?
questions_for_r3.why: Old visits and highest are not explicit confirmations; they cannot prove the four/six new ordered steps. No local fixture proves grandfathered Mirador.

questions_for_r3.question: Confirm role-specific Lía implementation source: authorize/adapt the existing shared five-petal layered rig for I/II, or supply compact missing action clip. Confirm named hand runtime path and pivot once root produces/registers it.
questions_for_r3.why: Current I and II render full-body pose bitmaps. The shared five-petal rig files exist but are not their active consumers. Translation/pose swap alone does not meet R1 new articulation.

questions_for_r3.question: Confirm root locale-aware content/functional-copy interface, catalog ownership and when ES/EN translations plus exact-spans/errata IDs are frozen for I/II.
questions_for_r3.why: 37 source records are available and can be bound locally, but changing document language does not refresh current static slot exports.

resume: Wait for root to register R3 reconciled contract and shared interfaces, then implement only accepted I/II scope.
